page.overview:
Who is Bradni Bronzebeard?

Bradni Bronzebeard is a treacherous Dwarf armourer and journeydwarf of the Bronzebeards Clan in Karak Norn, who has broken every oath he has ever sworn for the sake of glory and revenge.

Bradni Bronzebeard is the oldest and longest-serving of Master Harok Bronzebeard's journeymen, and therein lies the problem. Once a promising apprentice runesmith, Bradni swiftly rose to senior journeydwarf in Harok's workshop, but while his peers took their masterwork tests and moved on, Bradni never has. A Dawi journeydwarf must have his master's permission to take the test, and Harok has denied his requests again and again, saying only "You are not yet ready."

Over the decades, Bradni's pride turned to bitter resentment. He grew sure Harok envied his talent and feared Bradni would surpass him, coming to believe he was being held back. Bradni began to accompany Karak Norn trade missions to Reikland to escape his frustrations, and it was in Ubersreik that an agent of the Imperial Gold College contacted him. Somehow he knew of the journeydwarf's troubles and made an irresistible offer that promised Bradni glory and revenge.

A Gold College magister suspected Harok had a method of working the metal to enhance a rune's power. All Bradni had to do was learn this secret and bring it to the man in Ubersreik. If his information proved effective, he would be made a master smith in Altdorf with apprentices and a forge of his own.
